video.desc:
Kaelen, a husky shifter, is sold off by his gambling-addict stepfather to settle a debt. Fleeing his debt collectors, he falls off a cliff and stumbles into the forbidden territory of the wolf pack. Desperate to survive, he disguises himself as a werewolf and fights tooth and nail in the brutal "Wolf Queen Trials" to earn his place. What he doesn't know is that pack he saved leader Vaughn's life once before—ten years ago, when Kaelen was just a pup—and that Kaelen is Vaughn's "fated mate," the only one who can calm his full moon rampage. But surviving the trials is just the beginning. Kaelen is dragged into a secret storm threatening the pack's very existence—a traitor hidden within. In the end, kaelen's courage and pure heart shatter the walls of racial prejudice. He and Kaelen expose the traitor, break the pack free from their cage, and lead them to a new dawn.

哈士奇兽人Kaelen因嗜赌成瘾的继父欠债，被卖掉抵债。为躲避讨债人追杀，他跌落悬崖，意外闯入狼群的禁地。为求生存，他伪装成狼人，在残酷的"狼后试炼"中拼死一搏，只求换得一个立足之地。他不知道的是，狼群首领Vaughn十年前就曾被他救过命——那时Kaelen 还只是一只幼崽；他更不知道，自己正是Vaughn的"命定伴侣"，唯一能平息他满月狂暴发作的存在。然而活过试炼只是开始。Kaelen被卷入一场足以动摇整个狼群存续的秘密风暴——族群内部潜藏着一名叛徒。最终，Kaelen的勇气与纯粹本心击碎了种族偏见的高墙，他与Vaughn揪出叛徒，带领狼群冲破禁锢的牢笼，走向新生的曙光。
